findings.name: mutable_source_timestamp_survives_admission
findings.location: StudentPacketGate.receive validation and accepted StudentPacket construction
findings.evidence: StudentPacket(source_time=np.array(0.0), final=True) is accepted at now0. Mutating original array to99 after receive changes the accepted window timestamp to99 with no fault.
findings.fix: Require a finite real scalar, reject array/bool metadata and store an immutable canonical float in accepted packet. Test mutation/rejection explicitly.

findings.name: silent_dtype_conversion_breaks_exact_GoalFeatures_parity
findings.evidence: Float32 version of existing80-frame synthetic fixture is admitted but34 of80 windows differ from offline GoalFeatures; max component delta1.1920928955078125e-7. Offline task finite differences run in original input dtype; promotion before difference changes rounding.
findings.fix: Preserve supported prepared per-field dtype with bytes-backed storage and pin it for the epoch, or explicitly require canonical dtype and reject others. Cover float32/float64 and per-field dtype changes. Avoid silent promotion.

recorded_parity_review.verdict: Valid narrow evidence for current canonical prepared samples
recorded_parity_review.scope: Uses saved qpos/qvel, prior actions and BFM base; tests received goal encoding, not base actor inference or full online1069 observation generation.

scope_limits: Prepared samples only; no upstream raw-pose derivative causality proven.
Source50Hz and delivery-clock checks are enforced; controller consumption pacing is not. EOF is intentionally drained at one timestamp in parity harness and report correctly marks pacing unqualified.
Current synthetic data are float64; canonical recorded parity does not establish support for every dtype admitted by API.
No controller import/integration, transport, policy, physics, rearm/standing behavior or teleoperation qualification.
positive_checks: One packet carries original native, retargeted native and original task banks; invalid bank prevents queue admission.
Accepted numeric arrays are bytes-backed and mapping-protected; sender mutation and setflags cannot change admitted payload arrays.
True preceding task sample retained; local frame offset preserves backward task derivatives across full and explicitEOF windows.
FIFO sequence/epoch/sourceclock/delivery age and bounded queue fault rules preserve failure latch until explicit rearm.
